name: hold point
wording: exactly: a user story's read-back; its plan read-back, unless a task with no story; a change the operator asked to review before it joins; release; a fork irreversible, about value or beyond the architect's competence; any point the operator calls, stop included
reason: Cut to its departures: a cold read on two model families already carries that work passes a hold point only on its authority's release, which here is sign-off.
